title: Pay walls
note: Each line is a fee or paid-copy offer a body made in reply to a request. None has been paid.

items.note: Pay wall: RCAHMW (Royal Commission) asks £20 per high-resolution scan for high-resolution scans of microfiche and archive material (Great House Farm holdings); not paid
items.free_basis: Free to view; a copy can carry a reproduction charge (Fees Regulations reg 6; FOIA s.21 for records open to view).

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £15.60 first image, £4.80 each further image; £60.00 per hour for multiple documents for digital images of catalogued items (online order form); not paid
items.free_basis: Copy charge for records open to view in the searchroom.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks quote offered, no figure given for digital copies of any relevant records found (2026/2370); not paid
items.free_basis: Copy charge for records open to view in the searchroom.

items.note: Pay wall: RCAHMW (Royal Commission) asks per price list (figure not given in the reply) for document summary service; not paid
items.free_basis: A summary written to order is a service; FOIA gives access to recorded information as held (s.1).

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £19.50 (scanned image £3.40 + VAT, reproduction £12.85 + VAT) for digital copy of a newspaper extract; not paid
items.free_basis: Copy charge for a record open to view in the searchroom.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £38.50 next day or £12.50 standard post for copy certificates (two family records, 1990); not paid
items.free_basis: A certified copy certificate carries the set certificate fee; FOI has no free allowance for certificates.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £60 (including VAT) for up to one hour, payable in advance for staff research in burial and parish register entries; not paid
items.free_basis: The same reply offered a booked visit to view the registers in person, free.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £15.60 inclusive of VAT for copy of DBDT79/1 (1877 lease) and its plan; not paid
items.free_basis: Copy charge for a record open to view in the searchroom.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £50 including copies of relevant entries for staff search of rate books UC/73/1–5 and later volumes, with copies of entries; not paid
items.free_basis: The same reply (24 Sep 2026) points to the public searchroom, where the volumes can be read free.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £50 including copies of relevant pages for staff search of planning minutes for 1992/00671/RES and what they lead to; not paid
items.free_basis: The same reply (24 Sep 2026) points to the public searchroom, where the minutes can be read free.

items.note: Pay wall: RCAHMW (Royal Commission) asks charged search, per price list (scans free for orders under five) for aerial photograph searches and further searches (list of air-photo sorties; complex enquiries); not paid
items.free_basis: Asked as FOIA/EIR. Payment asked for air-photo searches per price list: no s.12 cost estimate, no s.16 advice to fit the £450 limit, and no free examination in place (EIR reg 8(2)(b)). Scans free under five.

items.note: Pay wall: ITV Archive asks £70 up to 15 min; £95 up to 30 min; £145 up to 60 min; £195 up to 90 min; £245 over 90 min, per programme for digital copies of programmes from the archive; not paid
items.free_basis: ITV is not listed in FOIA Schedule 1 (Channel Four is); archive copies are a commercial sale.

items.note: Pay wall: The National Archives asks paid search under the Public Records Act fees regulations, no figure given for search for the Valuation Office Survey 1910 entries (OS Glamorgan); not paid
items.free_basis: Reply of 12 Oct 2026 gave s.16 advice (identify the record, new request) and the free route: research the records at Kew. A further request was refused on 10 Nov 2026 as a repeat (s.14(2)).

items.note: Pay wall: Companies House asks £3 per document; £9 per pre-1973 accounts or annual return; £20 archive DVD for archive documents for Mountjoy Ltd (1926) and later companies (COH2382411X); not paid
items.free_basis: Filed documents are reasonably accessible on payment (FOIA s.21(2)(a)).

items.note: Pay wall: Mount Stuart (Bute archive) asks £20 per day for research visits for research visit to the Bute Estate (Glamorgan) records; not paid
items.free_basis: Mount Stuart is a private trust outside FOIA; £20 a day for research visits.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks paid search offered, no figure given for search of the closed 1988 Weekly Orders (South Wales Constabulary records); not paid
items.free_basis: Closed volumes: no access offered, only a paid search. No FOIA handling (free answer within 18 h, or a s.12 or exemption notice) and no s.16 advice on the free FOI route, to the archive or to the depositing force.

items.note: Pay wall: Cardiff Central Library asks scan cost via Glamorgan Archives; research charged, no figure given for scan of Bute X.6(12) (1877 trustee accounts) via Glamorgan Archives; detailed research; not paid
items.free_basis: Library scan and research charges for an item open to view.

items.note: Pay wall: British Geological Survey asks £12 + VAT per plan, or £18 + VAT where a hard copy must be scanned for PDF copies of mine and borehole plans (IDA 312230); not paid
items.free_basis: Mine and borehole plans are likely environmental information: a reasonable published charge is allowed, but not for examining in place. Whether in-place examination was offered: not checked.

items.note: Pay wall: Glamorgan Archives asks £50 an hour plus VAT, including a digitised image of any item found for staff searches of the remaining references (2026/4097): UC/73/1–5, DCVG/C/4/36, D696, DBDT/18/1, DBDT/79/1, ACA/8/2, estimated 1–3 hours each; not paid
items.free_basis: Reply of 30 Sep 2026 (2026/4097b): the records can be accessed free in the public searchroom; the paid staff search is the alternative.

items.note: Pay wall: RICS Library asks £10 + VAT per item retrieved, up to £250 + VAT for 25 volumes; scanning £15 + VAT per item up to 15 pages, £13 + VAT per further 15 pages; day pass £18 + VAT for RICS Year Books 1969–1993 (25 annual directory volumes); not paid
items.free_basis: RICS Library charges are a private service.

items.note: Pay wall: Llandough Community Council asks for a request within the £450 cost limit (an estimate of 37 hours) for its 2002–2016 minutes on the farm, the green and the verge; not paid — free allowance given first: yes
items.free_basis: Refused under s.12 at the £450 limit (18 h at £25/h; Fees Regs regs 3–4) with s.16 advice to narrow (e.g. 2002–2006). Open point: the 37-hour estimate counts time to assess each set of minutes, while reg 4(3) counts only determining, locating, retrieving and extracting. Internal review asked 13 Oct 2026.

items.note: Pay wall: Cabinet Office asks for a narrower request within the £600 cost limit for guidance on coordinating inconsistent replies between public authorities; not paid — free allowance given first: yes
items.free_basis: No charge asked. The £600 central-government limit (24 h at £25/h) was raised as likely, with an offer to help if the request is made more specific (s.16). No formal s.12 notice yet.

items.note: Pay wall: Land Registry Online (a private copy-ordering website) asks £32.99 for the title register and £24.99 for the title plan; not paid — free allowance given first: n/a
items.free_basis: Land Registry Online (uklandregistryonline.org.uk) is not a gov.uk service.
